npcReactions.text: His gloved hand drops instinctively toward his sword pommel as he measures the unnatural changes across your skin.
His storm-grey eyes linger on your scarred brow and heavy shoulders, weighing a fellow veteran.
His gaze settles on the Iron-Vow mail plates buckled across your ribs with tight approval.
His jaw tightens slightly at your pointed ears, though he keeps his boots planted behind the muster plank.
He measures your stance up and down before sliding his ledger closer, still doubtful of southern recruits.
She tuts softly at the sunken hollows under your cheekbones and reaches for a deeper ladle.
She eyes your old blade-marks with the tired sympathy of someone who has boiled too many bandages.
She pulls her shawl closer around her nose as a sharp, chalky smell lifts from your damp sleeves.
His flint-grey eyes soften half a fraction at the broad stone-cut set of your shoulders.
He taps a thumb against his halberd shaft, approving the oiled rivets along your mail.
He spits grit beside your boots, watching your pale fingers warily.
Her eyes drop straight to the ink-stains on your fingertips, brightening behind crooked wire frames.
She leans forward abruptly over her charcoal ruler, squinting at the unnatural sheen in your pupils.
His notched ears perk upright as he catches sight of familiar pointed features under your hood.
Yellow eyes widen greedily at the fitted metal seams tucked beneath your skin.
He clicks his teeth nervously at your damp grey cistern-weave before tucking his oil-flasks behind his heels.
Her blindfolded face turns smoothly toward the sharp metallic hum of your altered flesh.
Her veiled chin tilts slightly as though listening to slow rot ticking beneath your collar.
Her fingertips pause on the silk cords as the familiar woven cloth rustles across your shoulders.
She inclines her head toward the quiet, light tread of highland boots on wet marble.
He clutches his wax-crusted collar tight, eyeing the grey veining near your jaw.
His gaze catches the old chain-marks at your wrists and softens in tired kinship.
She turns an attentive ear toward your steady breathing along the marble gallery.
She notes your compact stride against the stone risers without raising her voice.
He glances at your lean ribs and nods toward the warm grate, making room beside his boots.
He cranes his neck up from the floor vent, shading his eyes against the tall shadow you cast.
Her amber eyes flick straight to the quick, bow-calloused set of your wrists with a crooked grin.
She tosses her Onyx coin twice, eyeing a fellow outcast with sharp street calculation.
He grunts warmly at your stout frame and lifts his heavy hammer in brief salute.
His ember-amber eyes catch the old kiln-burn along your skin and narrow with sudden respect.
He squints hard at the grafted rivets under your sleeve, muttering about sloppy flesh-work.
She blinks up from the bellows ropes at your broad shoulders, stepping back a pace.
She offers a quick, soot-smudged grin over the leather bellows frame.
His single dark eye traces the blade-mark across your cheek with grim appraisal.
He taps two knuckles against his spear shaft as he spots garrison iron at your chest.
He wipes salt dust off his nose and nods solidly to a kin-born traveler.
He squints through the orange glare at your pale skin, grunting that you look half-frozen already.
Milky eyes fix unblinkingly on the dark salt-taint pooling under your collar.
He taps his staff gently, remarking on how sharply northern chill bites long-lived blood.
Bog-green eyes gleam as she studies the fresh alterations seated under your skin.
She reaches toward your collar with vinegar-stained fingers before stopping herself with a sharp laugh.
He bows his raw forehead low at the sight of familiar iron-chain scars on your wrists.
His scrubbing stone stalls over the marble as he mutters a rapid salt prayer under his breath.
His unblinking grey gaze rests smoothly on your pale skin as though recognizing a quiet mirror.
He tilts his head slightly at your southern features, struggling briefly for a word that never comes.
Liquid-silver eyes ease slightly as she recognizes highland stride on the wet flagstones.
Her bow-hand stays ready, eyes tracking your notched ears suspiciously from behind the wain.
His bronze bell-helm tilts as he weighs your heavy frame against his own.
Through the visor slit, his gaze rests on the old scars showing beneath your collar.
Frost crackles on his breastplate as he notes battered Iron-Vow plates strapped across your chest.
His nostrils flare slightly as he takes in your greenskin hue, keeping one thumb hooked inside his belt.
His storm-grey eyes flick across your old burn scars with brief, grudging recognition.
He grunts approvingly at your weathered stone-toned skin, sizing up hold-bred grit.
He shifts his halberd grip across his knees, watching your sharp teeth without blinking.
He squints approvingly at the bright lantern-sheen in your eyes before tapping his oil flasks.
She pauses her charcoal stick, staring briefly at the cool silver gleam in your eyes.
Her blindfolded head tilts slightly as the marble tiles carry your heavy tread.
Her bog-green eyes trace the old ritual brand on your face with crooked kinship.
He glances up at your unmarked face and mutters that the north has not finished carving you yet.
His single dark eye runs down your harness, muttering that women rarely last three watches out here.
She nods toward your long {hair} hair, advising you to braid it tight before wind whips it across your bowstring.
Bronze plates creak slightly as he braces his weight against your heavy, planted stance.
